title: Member Catalog Deck Two
request: Oct 19 2026 11:48 ICT: Max submitted round one (branding-member-catalog-deck) and asked for round two refining his winners. Original ask 11:29 ICT: Max asked directly for a 20-card this-or-that deck to design the Members section of the UpKeep Members Command Center: an easy catalog of every Smart Upkeep member, organized into name and contact info, home info and membership info. Laptop-first, phone must work.
example_data: Drawn laptop SVG mockups with invented sample members only: fake names, (555) 000-01xx phones, @example.test emails, Sample St style streets, metro Detroit cities. Tagged SAMPLE.
built_at_note: Member Catalog Deck, Oct 19 2026 11:48 ICT round-two request
brands: Standard deck look (white, light beige accents, Khand/Hind)
